description: A draft announcement about a canceled lesson, in the school's language, for the office to review and publish.

content.text:
Draft an announcement about the canceled lesson 00000000-0000-7000-8000-00000000abcd, in English.

First find the lesson: call the tool `schedule` and look for the lesson with the ID 00000000-0000-7000-8000-00000000abcd. If you don't know its date, ask me for it, or search from today, 2026-09-22, in ranges of at most 42 days. If its status is not canceled, tell me so and stop.

Then write:

- a title of at most 120 characters that names the course type and the date;
- a body in plain text of at most 4000 characters: which lesson is canceled (course type, day, time in the school's time zone Europe/Berlin, room and location) and what the members need to know. Give a reason or an alternative only if I tell you one, and invent none.

Those booked for the lesson got a mail about the cancellation already. Suggest whom the announcement is for: the members of the lesson's class (and those booked for its coming lessons) or the members of its course type. "Participants of a lesson" reaches only those booked for the lesson.

This is a draft only: publish nothing. No tool saves an announcement, so give me the text only; the office reviews it and publishes it in the app.
